analysis.overall: You kept your glucose in range for 82% of the day, but experienced a few prolonged low drifts overnight and around midday alongside a couple of brief post-meal spikes.

events.title: Early evening dip
events.description: Glucose drifted down to 64 mg/dL after late-afternoon correction boluses, prompting a temporary target to help bring readings back up.

events.title: Overnight peak
events.description: Glucose slowly climbed late into the night following dinner and late boluses, reaching a peak of 200 mg/dL before corrections kicked in.

events.title: Early morning low
events.description: Multiple correction boluses from the overnight high caused glucose to drop to 62 mg/dL before leveling off.

events.title: Breakfast spike
events.description: A 35g carbohydrate breakfast led to a quick rise peaking at 168 mg/dL, which resolved within two hours back into range.

events.title: Midday low drift
events.description: Glucose gently drifted low again, hovering around 65-68 mg/dL for about an hour before rising back above 70 mg/dL.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Watch out for stacking late-night correction boluses, as they contributed to a sharp drop into a low early the next morning.
